Meta.title: GymSpot — The Fitness Marketplace
Meta.description: GymSpot connects gyms, elite coaches, and clients in one platform. Grow your gym, build your coaching career, or find your perfect training fit.

Hero.title: Where Gyms, Coaches & Clients
Hero.subtitle: GymSpot is the marketplace that brings the whole fitness world together. List your gym, grow your coaching career, or find the right place and people to reach your goals — all in one platform.

Gyms.label: For Gyms
Gyms.title: Fill Your Floor, Run It Smarter
Gyms.description: Put your gym in front of thousands of motivated members searching for their next home. Manage memberships, showcase your space, and hire vetted coaches — all from one dashboard.

visibility.title: Get Discovered
visibility.desc: Reach members actively searching for a gym in your area with a rich, searchable profile.

memberships.title: Sell Memberships
memberships.desc: Publish flexible membership plans and let clients subscribe directly through GymSpot.

hiring.title: Hire Top Coaches
hiring.desc: Post jobs and connect with verified coaches ready to grow your community.

insights.title: Track Performance
insights.desc: Understand your members and growth with clear, real-time insights.

Gyms.videoCaption: See how gyms grow with GymSpot

Coaches.label: For Coaches
Coaches.title: Build the Coaching Career You Deserve
Coaches.description: Showcase your certifications, transformations, and training style. Get discovered by clients and gyms, land jobs, and manage your roster — all in one professional profile.

profile.title: A Profile That Sells
profile.desc: Show off your specialties, certifications, and client transformations in one place.

jobs.title: Find Jobs Fast
jobs.desc: Browse and apply to coaching opportunities from gyms that fit your style.

clients.title: Grow Your Roster
clients.desc: Connect with motivated clients looking for exactly what you offer.

tools.title: Tools To Deliver
tools.desc: Chat, schedule, and manage clients without juggling a dozen apps.

Clients.label: For Clients
Clients.title: Find Your Gym. Find Your Coach. Crush Your Goals.
Clients.description: Discover gyms near you, compare memberships, and connect with the coach who gets your goals. GymSpot makes starting — and sticking with — your fitness journey effortless.

discover.title: Discover & Compare
discover.desc: Browse gyms and coaches with real photos, plans, and reviews you can trust.

match.title: Find Your Match
match.desc: Filter by goals, location, and style to find the coach and gym that fit you.

connect.title: Connect Instantly
connect.desc: Message gyms and coaches directly and start training without the back-and-forth.

Clients.videoCaption: See how members find their fit on GymSpot

Cta.title: Ready to Join the GymSpot Movement?
Cta.subtitle: Whether you run a gym, coach clients, or are starting your own journey — your spot is waiting.

Footer.tagline: The marketplace where the fitness world connects.
